name: pdk-tycoon-cli-pipeline
instr:
Our supplier now drops a daily stock export with only the rows that changed, and deletes old exports after a week. A few days of it are in /data/exports/. Pointed at that folder, `tycoon data sources run` reloads whatever files are there, so items disappear once their export is deleted and changed items show up more than once.

Filesystem sources need two new settings, on a `resources:` entry or under `config:` in the flat form: `primary_key`, a column name or a list of them, and `version_column`, the column saying when the row last changed. Setting only one of them should fail the run without writing anything. With both set, every run should leave the source's raw table with exactly one row per key, the row from that key's latest change, whichever export or run it came in. Keys whose exports are gone stay, and key values come through exactly as written. Running the same exports again, or loading them one export per run in any order, gives the same table as one run over all of them. CSV and JSON Lines exports both need to work.

If any row has an empty key or an empty or unreadable change time, the run should fail and leave the table as it was, and once that export is fixed or removed the next run should load normally. Sources without these settings work as before. The existing tests and the ruff checks in /app/CONTRIBUTING.md should still pass.

There's no network access.
